content: No single universal haul-length standard; Eurocontrol: short <1500km, medium 1500-4000km, long >4000km. UK CAA: short <1500km, medium 1500-3500km, long >3000km. US EPA: short <300mi, medium 300-2300mi, long >2300mi. American Airlines: short/medium <3000mi, long >3000mi. IATA time-based: short <3hr, medium 3-6hr, long 6-16hr. Recommend picking EPA or a round 3000-mile (~2600nm) threshold as the working US definition and citing it explicitly.
